criteria_location: Position Statement (~35 lines, p.2): two bulleted indication lists. List 1 gives 8 covered indications with a few qualifiers; List 2 gives 13 cancer sites for SBRT 'to treat a previously irradiated field'. No criteria beyond qualifiers in parentheses.
procedures_covered: Stereotactic body radiotherapy, delivery and management (77373, 77435, G0339, G0340)

logic.top_level: any (a list of covered indications, each a short phrase with optional qualifiers)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: None stated. Implicit exclusion of all unlisted indications (no catch-all investigational sentence in the Position Statement).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Second list is the re-irradiation pathway: 'Stereotactic body radiotherapy to treat a previously irradiated field meets the definition of medical necessity for the following indications:'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Oligometastases involving the lung, adrenal glands, and bone (other than spine or vertebral body)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and' means any of the sites, not all.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Primary renal cell carcinoma in members who are not good surgical candidates or who have metastatic renal cell carcinoma
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Two OR'd populations in one sentence; 'not good surgical candidates' undefined.

requirement_kinds.quote: Members with stage T1 or T2a non-small cell lung cancer (not >5 cm) showing no nodal or distant disease
who are not candidates for surgical resection
in members who have received prior spinal radiotherapy
Pancreatic cancer (locally advanced or recurrent disease without distant metastasis)
Prostate cancer (low, intermediate and high risk of recurrence, post-prostatectomy)

thresholds.quote: stage T1 or T2a non-small cell lung cancer (not >5 cm)

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Intro says 'Codes may not be all inclusive'. Codes cover delivery and planning; none mapped to an indication. Note 77373 and 77435 cap 'entire course not to exceed 5 fractions'.

external_dependencies.quote: For stereotactic radiosurgery, refer to Stereotactic Radiosurgery (Intracranial), 02-77371-01.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: a small number of new tumors (metastatic tumors (oligometastatic)) in one or two other parts of the body.

vague_terms.quote: alternative locoregional treatment for members with inoperable primary or metastatic lesions

extraction_hazards: Bullets are either the private-use character U+F0B7 or U+2022 depending on the document (the fusion guideline uses both), never '-' or '*'; nested bullets use other glyphs ('o') or only deeper indentation
Hyperlink navigation bar after the disclaimer is flattened into a 2-3 row text block that looks like headings
Form-feed (\f) page breaks can fall mid-list or immediately before a section heading, so '^HEADING' regexes can miss; no running headers/footers or page numbers to strip
POSITION STATEMENT heading is preceded by a form feed, so '^POSITION STATEMENT' misses it in this file (page 2 starts with it)
Typos in the lists ('cholangiocarcioma', 'mestatic lung lesions', 'Reonstructive')
Header has a 'Next Review:' line absent in most documents
Documents with identical LOINC documentation tables repeated
interesting_structures: Policy is almost entirely a whitelist of cancer types, not clinical criteria
Two lists by treatment context (first-line vs previously irradiated)
Page-14 References dominate the file (350 of 578 lines)

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Flat any-of of indications with few qualifiers; easy to represent but the chart needs a diagnosis/stage match, and 'not candidates for surgical resection' needs judgment.
